subtitles.en: After Congress tweaked the rules covering 529 plans in 2022, people without kids are now able to put money into those accounts after hitting the annual
subtitles.zh: 2022年国会调整了529计划规则后，没有孩子的人也可以在年度退休账户缴款限额用完后，向529账户存钱。

subtitles.en: limits for contributing to their retirement plans. So in a way, they treat the 529 as a backdoor for funding a Roth IRA. Sarah joins us along with Bloomberg, it's a jazz song. So,
subtitles.zh: 因此，他们某种程度上把529当作资助罗斯IRA的后门。莎拉加入我们，背景音乐是爵士乐。

subtitles.en: Sarah, let's just back up a little bit. 529 accounts are for you to put money away for your child or unborn child's college savings, or maybe even their high school savings if they're going to,
subtitles.zh: 莎拉，让我们先回顾一下。529账户是为你的孩子或未出生的孩子存大学学费，或者如果他们上私立学校，也可以存高中学费。

subtitles.en: you know, go to a private school. But if you're an avid saver, you could use it for something else as well.
subtitles.zh: 但如果你是个热衷储蓄的人，你也可以用它来做其他事情。

subtitles.en: Yeah, I think what's really interesting about the 529 is kind of this misconception that it's actually for your children. Actually, anybody can have their own 529 account. I can open up one for yourself.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为529真正有趣的地方在于，人们误以为它只适用于孩子。实际上，任何人都可以拥有自己的529账户。我可以为自己开一个。

subtitles.en: You can open up one for your children as well. You know, open one up for a niece or a nephew.
subtitles.zh: 你也可以为你的孩子开一个，或者为侄女侄子开一个。

subtitles.en: And I think a lot of people are really discovering here that since Congress tweaked the rules, there's a new way that they can kind of use it as like a wealth building strategy.
subtitles.zh: 我认为很多人发现，自从国会调整规则后，他们可以用它作为一种财富积累策略。

subtitles.en: So we spoke with people who are either opening these 529 accounts before they have children or before they even know they want them because they're using it as a way to maybe kind of put extra funds
subtitles.zh: 我们采访了一些人，他们在有孩子之前或甚至不确定是否要孩子之前就开设529账户，因为他们想利用它来将多余资金转入罗斯IRA，如果这些资金未被使用的话。

subtitles.en: into a Roth IRA if they go unused. What are the limitations to using a 529 account to fund retirement?
subtitles.zh: 使用529账户为退休提供资金有哪些限制？

subtitles.en: It's a very complicated process and a lot of the financial advisors that we spoke with say that it should probably kind of come in at the end, you know, after you've maxed out these other accounts,
subtitles.zh: 这是一个非常复杂的过程，我们采访的许多财务顾问表示，这应该在你已经用尽其他账户之后，最后才考虑。

subtitles.en: but you have to have the funds in your 529 plan for five years. You can only move up to 35,000 dollars
subtitles.zh: 但资金需在529计划中存放五年，且最多只能转出35,000美元。

clip_research.public_baseline: 529 plans are traditionally for education savings, but the SECURE 2.0 Act (passed in 2022) allows unused 529 funds to be rolled into a Roth IRA starting in 2024, subject to limits.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The claim highlights a novel use of 529 accounts by people without children as a backdoor to fund retirement, which is not the traditional purpose.
